title: Zesty Roasted Brazilian Beef Brisket Toast
description: A kid-friendly Brazilian dish featuring roasted beef brisket served on toast, perfect for a family dinner. The dish is kosher-friendly and cooked to perfection on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef brisket with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef brisket until browned on both sides, then transfer to the oven.
Roast the beef brisket for 3 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
Shred the roasted beef brisket and serve on top of the toasted bread.
Drizzle with lime juice and top with butter.
Serve immediately on a hot stone plate.
